name: StartCommunicationProcessing
transaction_boundary: one short LLD-01 UnitOfWork to revalidate scope/trackable gate and enqueue or coalesce one ordinary durable job
guards: at least one trackable operational target
processing request does not imply Deep Scan
initial boundary available or existing forward checkpoint permits bounded continuation
receipt_order: replay -> revalidate -> insert command_receipt -> durable job + communication_job_scope -> audit/results -> commit
revision_effects: no source/domain revision change; replay/coalescing returns existing job identity
post_commit_work: LLD01 worker executes registered ORDINARY job
